paragraph: I grew up in Nike. I watched Olympians race in it, and to me it always stood for innovation, history, and a culture that puts athletes in the best possible environment to perform. When I was recruited to row in college, I didn't see a non-Nike school as an option, so I committed to USC. I always believed Nike schools were the best, so I tested it: they are, but mostly because Nike partners with programs that are already elite. Asking a question I cared about and letting the data answer it honestly is exactly the kind of work I want to do at Nike.
